summary: Eight shots that strictly alternate a "sentence" shot (2.3-2.8 s: two lyric lines typed into orange serif chat bubbles while a cream user reply or click lands) with a "keyword" shot (0.9-1.4 s: the ALL-CAPS word slammed in letter by letter as giant glowing orange serif). Everything on screen is chat-client furniture drawn in code: bubbles, Delivered ticks, an action row, a heart chip, the cursor, the composer, the window outline, a blurred brown backdrop and a dark sunburst watermark. The only pictures are the untreated painted tea illustration as a tall picture message in c1-happy (plus a 100x150 thumbnail of it in c1-trap/c1-kw4) and a dot-screen of the standing "gaze" cut-out behind the thread in c1-trap/c1-kw4. Colour state goes on > warm, stepping hotter each time a cream reply lands (heat 0.2 at 59.42, 0.4 at 61.27, 0.65 at 62.42, 1.0 from 66.34). The four keyword shots are four variants of one card: same typeface, same slam, same brown blur, same watermark; none shows a picture of what the word means. Frames I rendered are in <scratchpad> (chorus1_1..5.png contact sheets, chorus1_f1..f7.png full size).

diagnosis:
What the frames show, as opposed to what the code comments intend:

1. The four keyword shots are one card shown four times. Each is the word itself in Source Serif 900, orange with a halo, slammed in with identical parameters (slam step 0.022 s, from 1.9x, settle 0.13), on the same blurred brown ground (page() with the blurred tea picture) with the same dark sunburst watermark. The word is the subject; there is no picture. The director's "not concrete enough" is literal: a noun is being answered with its own spelling.

2. The things meant to carry meaning are small, abstract and made of UI parts. STIMULATIONS: "two-way traffic" is rows of dark pills with line stubs, which read as loading skeletons; nothing sensory or electric. SATISFACTION: the idea is right (a thumbs-up under the answer) but the button is 80 px wide, about 4 % of the frame, beside a 1490-px word, and half the frame is empty. EXECUTION: a sunburst filling petal by petal is a progress ring behind a title; nothing says "run". SIMULATION: the whole client at 80 % scale; correct as an idea, but it is the interface the viewer has been looking at for 73 seconds, so it does not register as a new image.

3. The hits are soft. Each word needs 0.33-0.40 s (most of a beat) to assemble, so there is no single impact frame; the only accent is a 0.3 orange full-field flash on kw1, kw2 and kw4, and kw3 has none. The cuts of kw1 and kw3 fall on off-beats (133.5 and 149.5, hi-hat, low-band about 0.3) because H() snaps the LRC time to the nearest half-beat; the kick (low-band 0.85-1.0, on every integer beat) arrives 0.23 s later, in the middle of the letter cascade. Only kw2's thumbs-up (65.88) and question (66.34) land on kicks.

4. Monotony is measurable here: 14.77 s, 8 shots, 100 % chat furniture; six of eight shots share the page() backdrop; the dark sunburst sits in a corner of five. Variation is only in bubble size and position.

5. The art clash is concentrated in c1-happy. tea.png is a fully painted, soft-shaded picture with a pastel green and yellow greenhouse, the only place in the section where colours outside orange / cream / charcoal appear, at 37 % of the frame width and full height against flat matte UI. It recurs as a thumbnail in c1-trap and c1-kw4. The gaze halftone behind the thread reads as an orange dotted cone, not as a person.

6. The request collides with the v3 contract. docs/v3/PLAN.md section 1 ("which moment of this conversation is this? If there is no answer, the content goes"), section 3.4 and KIT.md section 3 items 1 and 6 ("Nothing on screen is decoration", "No clip-art ... typography, data cards and charts instead") are exactly why these shots contain no pictures. A v4 brief has to relax those rules explicitly for full-screen non-UI inserts and flat silhouette / code-symbol graphics, otherwise a builder following KIT.md will reproduce the same result.

Replaceability summary: all four keyword shots can become, or cut away to, a full-screen non-UI graphic without losing a lyric line, provided the keyword text stays readable for its sung window and the pickup line that begins inside kw1 / kw2 / kw3 (lines 35, 38, 41) is shown from its start. kw3 and kw1 are free of unique story content; kw2 owns the thumbs-up and the question; kw4 owns the "one window round both" pay-off. The four sentence shots (c1-give, c1-only, c1-happy, c1-trap) each carry two typed lyric lines plus the user's replies and cannot be replaced without re-homing those lines; c1-happy and c1-trap need new art rather than a new structure.

timing_constraints: Grid: 130 BPM, beat 0 at 0.344 s, P = 0.4615 s. Section = beats 128-160. Cuts only on beats / half-beats via B(), H(), Bt() or c[i] + n*P, never raw numbers.

Drums (data/audio_features.json): a kick on every integer beat (low band 0.8-1.0), hi-hat on every half-beat (low about 0.3). Exceptions: beats 152 and 153 (70.50, 70.96) are lighter (0.71, 0.57) and there is NO kick on the bar line at beat 160 = 74.19 (low 0.29): the music drops out into verse 2.

Keyword sung windows (LRC): STIMULATIONS 61.96-62.59 (1.4 beats); SATISFACTION 65.40-66.60 (2.6 beats); EXECUTION 69.26-70.08 (1.8 beats); SIMULATION 73.17-74.05 (1.9 beats). KIT rule: the keyword must be readable for the whole window and be the visual peak of its phrase.

Kicks available for flash-ins inside each keyword shot: kw1 62.19, 62.65 (cut at 61.96 is an off-beat); kw2 65.42, 65.88, 66.34; kw3 69.57, 70.04 (cut at 69.34 is an off-beat; kick at 69.11 precedes the sung onset by 0.15 s); kw4 73.27, 73.73.

Shot lengths: kw1 2.5 beats (2 clean, push lead-in 62.88-63.11), kw2 3 beats, kw3 2.5 beats, kw4 2 beats (0.92 s). A half-beat is 0.23 s = 14 frames at 60 fps; the current letter cascade alone takes 0.33-0.40 s.

Pickup lines that begin inside keyword shots and must be on screen from their start: line 35 at 62.59 (in kw1), line 38 at 66.60 (in kw2), line 41 at 70.08 (in kw3). Line 44 (verse 2) starts at 74.05, 0.145 s before the cut at 74.19, and is not shown in kw4 today.

User events already pinned to the grid: "ok, that's good" 59.42; "more" 61.27 (kick); compliment 62.42 (off-beat); marker underline 64.27; thumbs-up 65.88 (kick); question 66.34 (kick); heart 68.19 (kick); composer click 72.34 (kick); window outline trace 70.30-72.26.
Colour heat steps: 0.2 at 59.42, 0.4 at 61.27, 0.65 at 62.42, 1.0 at 66.34 (each eased over 0.45 s); kw3 and kw4 sit at full warm.

Engine limits: two shots live at once at most; a transition's dur is clamped to fit between neighbouring cuts (shot.js sequence). A lead-in into v2-eggplant with align 'end' would eat into kw4's 0.92 s.
Typing speed: 26 chars/s, capped at 60 % of the line's duration (config.json typing).

Safety: no strobing, no pulsing on every beat, nothing reshuffled per frame (KIT.md 3.9); flashes capped at 0.7, currently 0.30-0.35 on four cuts in 15 s. Beat flash-ins should be hard-cut holds of at least half a beat, not alternating bright and dark fields.
Render must stay a pure function of t (no state, no Math.random; rand() from engine/prng.js).
